speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Manpower (Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong) (for the Minister for Manpower)
text: With more than 2,500 employment agencies (EAs) licenced to place MDWs, EAs have to take into account market competition when they are pricing their services.

speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Manpower (Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong) (for the Minister for Manpower)
text: We provide information on Ministry of Manpower's (MOM's) online EA directory to enable employers to compare EAs' track record such as customer service ratings, years of service, and retention and transfer rate of MDWs when choosing EAs.

speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Manpower (Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong) (for the Minister for Manpower)
text: MOM also has measures in place to protect MDWs' employers' legitimate interest.

speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Manpower (Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong) (for the Minister for Manpower)
text: Prospective employers may use the FDW e-service portal to assess information about MDWs' past work performance, length of each employment and reasons why these MDWs left their past employment before hiring.

speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Manpower (Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong) (for the Minister for Manpower)
text: We will continue to regularly review and enhance our measures to safeguard the interests of employers and build a system that is fair to both employers and MDWs.

speaker: Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong
text: This competition encourages the EA to differentiate their services and their quality and their price.

speaker: Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong
text: To note, like what I have mentioned, there are already fee caps on EAs, the amount that they can charge the MDWs, which I mentioned in my reply.

speaker: Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong
text: And with the data available on the EA directory, such as customer service ratings, years of service, employers can make a more informed decision on pricing.

speaker: Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong
text: In terms of affordability, there are also other schemes that will provide financial services to families with much heavier caregiving needs.

speaker: Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong
text: I have also mentioned about levy concessions for needy households.

speaker: Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong
text: Those households who need further assistance can approach social services for additional financial assistance.
